exports.n: customs gross weight 186.7 t; Customs data record 186 t of platinum-group metals from the United Arab Emirates to India in 2024 (CEPII BACI), 92% of India's recorded imports, against 2.0 t in 2023. They are declared at 9,338 USD per kg, 30% of the 2024 average platinum price (30,712 USD per kg, World Bank Pink Sheet). Gold or another cheaper metal declared as a platinum alloy is a plausible cause; it is not established here; rank 7: the United Arab Emirates is not in the USGS list of platinum-group producers; its exports may be re-exports of metal traded and refined there (a possible reading, not established here)
